Geographic focus:

Temporal focus:
T1. Historical observation [YES] — Reported index closes, earnings results, PCE data
T2. Forward-looking immediate [YES] — Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech, rate policy signals, Nvidia revenue outlook
T3. Long-term development [YES] — AI infrastructure buildout trajectory, sustained AI demand cycle

Synopsis:
Nvidia's blowout revenue forecast (+70% YoY, well above consensus ~40%) reignited the AI trade, lifting NASDAQ +1.57% and the SOX +2.3% while the broader market was mixed. Software names (Salesforce +22.6%, CrowdStrike +20.5%) validated AI's expanding monetization beyond chips. Offsetting factors: hotter PCE data, two Fed officials reiterating hawkish inflation concerns, and geopolitical risk (Iran/Trump MOU breakdown lifting crude >$2/bbl). Market attention pivots to Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole address, expected to signal skepticism toward prior policy assumptions without being declarative. Labor market remains stable (jobless claims declining second straight week).
